voice.summary: Kinetic Type Lab talks like a type designer on a good day: excited about letterforms and quick to share the trick. Sentences are short, active and full of motion verbs.
dos: Describe each effect by what the letters do
Use motion verbs: type, scramble, sweep, fill
donts: Do not claim any effect is 'revolutionary'
Do not explain the code in the headline
Do not use more than one exclamation mark

taglines: Pick one, change the words, replay
Type that moves, on your terms
boilerplate: Kinetic Type Lab is a small showcase of six kinetic text effects built with CSS and JavaScript, which visitors can edit and replay.

microcopy.success: Effect applied. Press Replay to watch it again.
microcopy.error: That text is too long for this effect. Try fewer words.
microcopy.empty: Type some words to see them move.

logo.note: A bold letter K is itself a moving shape of type.
